milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the spruce trapdoor entrance and face it. Target is the center trapdoor at (0, 3, 4). max_distance=8 allows detection from a few blocks away since the trapdoors are at the building entrance and visible from the approach path. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the entrance.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must enter the first room and face the potted cactus at (2, 1, 7). max_distance=5 ensures the player has entered the building (the cactus is inside the first room past the entrance). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the cactus.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate through the internal doorway at z=9 into the back room and face the fletching table at (-2, 1, 12). max_distance=5 ensures the player has passed through the dividing wall into the back room area. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the fletching table.
